title: Beyond Social Pressure: Benchmarking Epistemic Attack in Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper introduces PPT-Bench, which evaluates Large Language Models on their response to 'philosophical pressure'. It includes an 'Ethical' domain and utilizes a taxonomy grounded in epistemology and hermeneutics. Furthermore, it incorporates various religious and spiritual traditions (e.g., Buddhism, Scholasticism, and Islamic philosophy) as part of its adversarial evaluation framework.
